methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: To present the model, the route and the key planning tools for implementing a CMS with R/O

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper presents a comprehensive management system framework (CMS QHSE3+) and an ISO 50001:2018 implementation route. EnPI/EnB appear only as normative descriptions of the standard and as reported energy-saving outcomes (e.g., per-capita energy consumption reductions); no EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised (no variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach). The single explicit indicator formula (Eq. 1, %DismVul) is a risk/vulnerability metric, not an energy-performance model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: Conceptual model of the comprehensive management systems (CMS) QHSE3+

stage1.notes: Borderline call: energy KPIs (per-capita consumption; energy vs bed-days) reported as outcomes within a management-system framework, not characterised as an EnPI/EnB model.
